scripts.title: Average Script Hub
scripts.script:
if game.PlaceId == 104753750317341 then
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://sirius.menu/gen2"))()

local ms = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

local window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
name = "Gym Legends Script | ".. ms:GetProductInfo(game.PlaceId).Name,
subtitle = "Made With Rayfield Gen2",
sidebarLayout = true,
theme = "cobalt",
})

local tab = window:CreateTab({ name = "Main", icon = 93364949241311 })

-- Important Variables to make the script function
local Event = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.muscleEvent
local ocr = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").rEvents.openCrystalRemote
local sas = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").rEvents.changeSpeedSizeRemote
local reb = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").rEvents.rebirthRemote
local v = false
local v1 = false
local SelectedC = "Blue Crystal"
local v2 = false

-- Paths
local rt = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.RebirthTokens
local t = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Tokens
local g = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Gems
local dur = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Durability
local ag = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Agility
local autor = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.autoRebirthEnabled
local mon = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.musicOn
local tron = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.tradingOn

-- chests
local lc = workspace.legendsChest.circleInner
local gc = workspace.goldenChest.circleInner
local gr = workspace.groupRewardsCircle.circleInner
local ec = workspace.enchantedChest.circleInner
local mc = workspace.magmaChest.circleInner
local mc2 = workspace.mythicalChest.circleInner

-- general
local function hrp()
  return game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local rep = tab:CreateToggle({
name = "Auto Rep (Doesn't Work On Machines)",
flag = "AutoRep",
value = false,
callback = function(vl)
v = vl

if v then  
         task.spawn(function()  
             while v do  
               Event:FireServer("rep")  
               task.wait(0.07)  
             end  
         end)  
     else  
          v = false  
     end  
end,

})

local punch = tab:CreateToggle({
name = "Auto Punch",
flag = "AutoPunch",
value = false,
callback = function(value)
v1 = value

if v1 then
task.spawn(function()
while v1 do
Event:FireServer("punch", "leftHand")
task.wait(0.07)
Event:FireServer("punch", "rightHand")
task.wait(0.07)
end
end)
end
end,
})

local AutoRebirth = tab:CreateToggle({
name = "Auto Rebirth",
flag = "AutoRebirth",
value = false,
callback = function(value)
if value == true then
autor.Value = true
else
autor.Value = false
end
end,
})

tab:CreateButton({
    name = "Rebirth",
    callback = function()
     reb:InvokeServer("rebirthRequest")
end,
})

local ptab = window:CreateTab({ name = "Pets", icon = 93364949241311 })

ptab:CreateDropdown({
    name = "Select Crystals",
    multiSelect = false,
    options = { "Blue Crystal", "Battle Legends Crystal", "Dark Nebula Crystal", "Frost Crystal", "Galaxy Oracle Crystal", "Green Crystal", "Inferno Crystal", "Legends Crystal", "Muscle Elite Crystal", "Mythical Crystal", "Ultra Shockwave Crystal" },
    value = { "Blue Crystal" },
    callback = function(selected)
        SelectedC = selected
    end,
})

ptab:CreateInput({
    name = "Open Crystal By Number",
    numeric = true,
    value = "0",
    placeholder = "Enter a number",
    callback = function(num)
        for i = 1, num do
            ocr:InvokeServer("openCrystal", SelectedC)
        end
    end,
})

ptab:CreateButton({
    name = "Open Crystal",
    callback = function()
        ocr:InvokeServer("openCrystal", SelectedC)
    end,
})

ptab:CreateToggle({
name = "Auto Open Crystal",
flag = "AutoOpenCrystal",
value = false,
callback = function(value)
v2 = value

if v2 then
task.spawn(function()
while v2 do
ocr:InvokeServer("openCrystal", SelectedC)
task.wait(0.1)
end
end)
end
 end,
})

local misc = window:CreateTab({ name = "Misc", icon = 93364949241311 })

misc:CreateInput({
    name = "Enter Agility Amount",
    numeric = true,
    value = "0",
    placeholder = "Enter a number",
    callback = function(text)
        ag.Value = text
    end,
})

misc:CreateInput({
    name = "Enter Durability Amount",
    numeric = true,
    value = "0",
    placeholder = "Enter a number",
    callback = function(text)
        dur.Value = text
    end,
})

misc:CreateInput({
    name = "Enter Token Amount",
    numeric = true,
    value = "0",
    placeholder = "Enter a number",
    callback = function(text)
        t.Value = text
    end,
})

misc:CreateInput({
    name = "Enter Gems Amount",
    numeric = true,
    value = "0",
    placeholder = "Enter a number",
    callback = function(text)
        g.Value = text
    end,
})

misc:CreateInput({
    name = "Enter Rebirth Token Amount",
    numeric = true,
    value = "0",
    placeholder = "Enter a number",
    callback = function(text)
        rt.Value = text
    end,
})

misc:CreateText({
    name = "Size and Speed",
    text = "Size and Speed Changing",
})

misc:CreateInput({
    name = "Enter Size",
    numeric = true,
    value = "0",
    placeholder = "Enter a number",
    callback = function(num)
        sas:InvokeServer("changeSize", tonumber(num))
    end,
})

misc:CreateInput({
    name = "Enter Speed",
    numeric = true,
    value = "0",
    placeholder = "Enter a number",
    callback = function(num)
        sas:InvokeServer("changeSpeed", tonumber(num))
    end,
})

misc:CreateText({
    name = "Music And Trading",
    text = "Music and Trade Related Things",
})

local tradeon = misc:CreateToggle({
name = "Trade On/Off",
flag = "AutoOnAOff",
value = false,
callback = function(value)
if value == true then
tron.Value = false
else
tron.Value = true
end
end,
})

misc:CreateButton({
    name = "Change Music",
    callback = function()
local musicFolder = workspace:WaitForChild("musicFolder")
local v1
local currentMap = game.Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("currentMap")
local u4

local function u4_2(v2)
    local v3 = musicFolder:FindFirstChild(v2)
    if v3 ~= nil then
        local v4 = v3:GetChildren()[math.random(1, #v3:GetChildren())]
        if v4 ~= nil then
            for v5, v6 in pairs(musicFolder:GetDescendants()) do
                if v6 ~= nil and v6:IsA("Sound") then
                    v6:Pause()
                end
            end
            if v1 ~= nil then
                v1:Disconnect()
            end
            local v7
            if v4.Parent == nil then
                v7 = true
            elseif v4.Parent.Name == "Boxing Ring" or v4.Parent.Name == "Desert Ring" then
                v7 = false
            else
                v7 = v4.Parent.Name ~= "Magma Ring"
            end
            if v7 == true then
                v4:Resume()
            else
                v4:Play()
            end
            v1 = v4.Ended:Connect(function()
                v1:Disconnect()
                u4(currentMap.Value)
            end)
        end
    end
end

u4 = u4_2
u4_2(currentMap.Value)
currentMap.Changed:Connect(function()
    u4_2(currentMap.Value)
end)
    end,
})

local Chests = window:CreateTab({ name = "Chests", icon = 93364949241311 })

Chests:CreateButton({
    name = "Open The Legends Chest",
    callback = function()
     local hrp = hrp()
     firetouchinterest(lc, hrp, 0)
     task.wait()
     firetouchinterest(lc, hrp, 1)
end,
})

Chests:CreateButton({
    name = "Open The Golden Chest",
    callback = function()
     local hrp = hrp()
     firetouchinterest(gc, hrp, 0)
     task.wait()
     firetouchinterest(gc, hrp, 1)
end,
})

Chests:CreateButton({
    name = "Open The Group Chest",
    callback = function()
     local hrp = hrp()
     firetouchinterest(gr, hrp, 0)
     task.wait()
     firetouchinterest(gr, hrp, 1)
end,
})

Chests:CreateButton({
    name = "Open The Enchanted Chest",
    callback = function()
     local hrp = hrp()
     firetouchinterest(ec, hrp, 0)
     task.wait()
     firetouchinterest(ec, hrp, 1)
end,
})

Chests:CreateButton({
    name = "Open The Magma Chest",
    callback = function()
     local hrp = hrp()
     firetouchinterest(mc, hrp, 0)
     task.wait()
     firetouchinterest(mc, hrp, 1)
end,
})

Chests:CreateButton({
    name = "Open The Mythical Chest",
    callback = function()
     local hrp = hrp()
     firetouchinterest(mc2, hrp, 0)
     task.wait()
     firetouchinterest(mc2, hrp, 1)
end,
})
end
scripts.features:
Gym Legends Script with

Auto rep
Auto punch
Auto Rebirth
Rebirth Single time
- pets -
Select Crystal
Open crystal with multiple elements at once
- misc -
Music, trading and currency related things (Client Side only)
- chests -
Opens Chests (thats it)
